rule: Every dynamic import / exec / eval / spec_from_file_location site in a production entry must be listed with its helper line, every call site, every line the target argument comes from, and the resolved target files, each pinned by line sha256. The gate fails if any pinned line changes, if the helper gains an unlisted call, if a target file named here is not literally present in its arg-source lines or does not exist, or if an 'unused' helper is called. Runtime-built targets (environment, input, concatenation) cannot be pinned and therefore fail.
scope_note: All five sites are in tests/ files that workflows run as checks; none is in a script that writes production output. tests/test_v610a_playbook_engine.py defines load_module but never calls it (used=false, not counted as an executed dynamic import).
static_boundaries: JS/TS: only literal import()/require targets are resolved; module graphs of docs/ assets are not followed (all docs/*.js files are scanned directly as front-end entries)
composite / reusable GitHub Actions (uses: ./.github/actions/... or other repos) are not expanded; none exist in this repo today
only .github/workflows/*.yml are read; a *.yaml workflow would be missed — the gate fails if one exists
paths built from runtime data cannot be seen by any static scan; such dynamic sites must be pinned here or they fail
